## Change

Describe the concrete behavior and why it is needed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Required tests and build checks pass.
- [ ] Preview verification evidence is attached or linked.
- [ ] Security findings, fixes, and remaining limits are documented accurately.
- [ ] Accessibility checks cover changed user flows.
- [ ] No private credentials, environment files, or unrelated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Deployment/rollback steps are recorded when applicable.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. Identify checks that remain pending.

## Review And Release

Human review and public deployment approval remain separate from automated checks.
